Annotators label each summary for seven error types: Extrinsic Information, Mis‑Referencing, Stating Opinion As Fact, Reasoning Error, Tense/Modality Error, Contradiction, Nuanced Meaning Shift.

The seven dimensions of human annotation used in TofuEval correspond to seven error types: Extrinsic Information (EI), Mis-Referencing (MR), Stating Opinion As Fact (SOAF), Reasoning Error (RE), Tense/Modality Error (TME), Contradiction (CO), Nuanced Meaning Shift (NMS).
